gap: No result ChatGPT got states that ESR's own store sells its 25W CryoBoost 3-in-1 stand and its OmniLock 25W vent car charger as one bundle SKU for $149.13, which is $23.85 less than buying the two separately at esrgear.com ($172.98) and $7.85 less than buying them separately on Amazon ($156.98). The car half fits only vent blades 10–32 mm wide and 1–4 mm thick, and it does not fit round or bladeless vents.
standout_why: I checked against the cited Apple Support 105047 (en-us), which I opened. It covers adapter wattage per iPhone (a 30W or larger adapter rated 15V/2A for 25W) but says nothing about cars, bundles or carts. ChatGPT's answers priced Belkin, Anker, UGREEN and Apple items as separate purchases from different stores, so none of them is a one-cart kit. The ESR OmniLock page did appear in its results (rank 12, not cited), but ChatGPT never mentioned the home + car bundle SKU, its price, or the vent-blade size limits. It only asked the shopper what car they drive.
kit_items: Home charger: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charging Station (25W, Qi2.2), US plug. It charges iPhone, Watch and AirPods with 25W Qi2.2 and active cooling, and Dealectric already lists it as esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand.
Car charger: ESR OmniLock Magnetic Car Charger (25W, CryoBoost, Air Vent). Qi2.2 25W, N52 magnets rated to 1,600 g, and the vent hook fits blades 10–32 mm wide and 1–4 mm thick.

Best way to buy both: ESR's own bundle SKU '25W CryoBoost 3-in-1 Magnetic Charger (Qi2) and Car Charger (Air Vent) Bundle – US Plug', $149.13. That's one link and one cart, and it costs less than the two items separately.
